slots.rule: The household whose electric car moved its use the most, with the supplier's inference set against it
slots.glossary: An EV home: an electric car arrives, and the supplier sees it only as more electricity on the meter.
slots.reason: No household in this run passes this example's checks yet. 6 households match the rule, and each fails at least one check an energy reader would apply: its electricity over the year after the car did not rise by the 1,750-3,300 kWh an EV adds (4 of 6); the car's effect its record states is not the 1,750-3,300 kWh a year an EV adds (4 of 6); it lacks a full year of electricity use either side of the car (1 of 6); it holds no electricity supply with us (1 of 6).
